plan.title: Recreate Order Rejects Past Scheduled Time

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ with the stated bids.
Enable automatic event scheduling required by the case.
Enable eRFX projects required by the case.
Open the stage menu and launch the Recreate Order pop-up.

args.goal: In the Recreate Order pop-up, tick 'Schedule this event?', choose today with a time one hour before now, click 'Create Order', and verify that the pop-up remains open showing the refusal 'Invalid scheduled time!' or 'Scheduled time is invalid!' with no new event created

steps.note: Perform and verify the recreate-order scheduling refusal, including the dialog remaining open.
Assert the expected refusal message is visible.
